named_mechanism: Fourier-based Kolmogorov–Arnold module inside a graph neural network
definition: Replace at least one standard MLP transformation in message passing/readout with a Fourier-feature univariate expansion followed by learnable linear mixing
Preserve graph message passing over molecular adjacency
assumptions: SMILES-derived molecular graphs can approximate the required graph input
Non-covalent interactions can be approximated through topological or feature-derived context if no 3D conformers are used
invariants: Same train/validation/test split protocol across compared models
Same featurization and optimizer settings where possible
Architecture difference isolated primarily to MLP vs Fourier-KA block
non_negotiable_structural_steps: Train at least one baseline GNN with MLP transform
Train at least one KA-inspired GNN replacing that transform
Export direct comparison metrics and interpretability artifact
